prompt: Image 1 is a flat-colour 3D sculpt of a game character, rendered by an orthographic camera hovering directly above the top of its head and looking straight down at the floor: a plan view, like a miniature seen from above on a tabletop battle map. The figure stands bolt upright with both arms stretched straight out to the sides. The round dome in the centre is the top of its skull: the whole circle, rim to rim, is one unbroken smooth scalp shaded as a sphere, with the crown and a single soft highlight at its exact centre, and the rim of the circle all the way round is the widest part of the skull. At the middle of the dome's lower rim a small rounded nose tip pokes out, with one tiny ivory tusk point on each side of it, and a pointed ear sticks out sideways from each side of the dome. The wide horizontal band running through the dome is the tops of the shoulders, the trapezius and the upper back. The level bars to the left and right are the arms seen from above, ending in flat hands with the backs of the hands, the knuckles and the spread fingers facing the camera. The rounded shelf below the shoulder band is the top surface of the chest seen from above, and the two rows of small rounded nubs at the very bottom are the tips of the toes resting on the floor far below. Paint this exact sculpt as a finished game character: an orc with olive-green skin, a bald scalp, pointed ears, heavy muscles and ivory tusk tips. Keep the identical outline, pose, proportions, position, scale and straight-down viewpoint, tracing the silhouette precisely and keeping every shape exactly where and how large the sculpt has it. Paint the dome as a smooth scalp filling the entire circle. Paint the shoulder band as trapezius, deltoid and shoulder-blade muscles seen from above, the arms as level bars of biceps and forearm muscle, and each hand with five well-formed fingers, knuckles and fingernails. Paint each small nub at the bottom as one short toe end with a toenail, the same size as in the sculpt. Bare unclothed base body, left-right symmetric, lit evenly from directly above, on a perfectly flat uniform mid-grey background, RGB 128 128 128, that fills the rest of the picture. Image 2 is a small close-up swatch of this character's painted skin, for colour and finish only: match its fresh saturated olive-green hue, its lighter yellow-green highlights, its smooth cel-like painted shading with broad soft highlights and clean muscle-separation lines, and its crisp dark green outline of varying weight, across the whole figure.
